bio: Located in the middle of the village, this traditional establishment serves good regional and seasonal cuisine. The menu features mouth-watering dishes such as braised beef cheek in a Pinot noir sauce. Opt for a four-course set menu or order à la carte. The house proposes its own organic wines. Very friendly and well-drilled service, a cosy interior, and a lovely terrace laid out under the wisteria. The hotel of the same name has stylish, classic guestrooms....
